dialogues.speaker: Seiji
dialogues.text: It's nothing like Inazuma! Everything here is so new and fresh!

dialogues.speaker: Seiji
dialogues.text: Let's start with their god, then. I've heard that she lost her memory for ages, and has only recently started directing the Akademiya again!

dialogues.speaker: Seiji
dialogues.text: In Inazuma, we've believed in Her Excellency for generations, so it's difficult to comprehend that a god could be left out in the cold like that.

dialogues.speaker: Seiji
dialogues.text: Also, the curry here is hardly sweet at all! Fascinating. Just fascinating...
